Hymn 98: I Need Thee Every Hour
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Robert Lowry
Lyricist/Text Author: Annie S. Hawks
Category: Prayer and Supplication

This is hymn number 98 titled "I Need Thee Every Hour" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Robert Lowry and the lyrics were written by Annie S. Hawks.
This hymn is categorized under: Prayer and Supplication.
